series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2027, GenAI and AI agent use will create the first true challenge to mainstream productivity tools in 30 years, prompting a $58 billion market shakeup
entries.subject: GenAI disruption of productivity tools

entries.quote: By 2027, 75% of hiring processes will include certifications and testing for workplace AI proficiency during recruiting
entries.subject: AI proficiency testing in hiring
entries.metric: share of hiring processes with AI proficiency certification or testing

entries.quote: Through 2026, atrophy of critical-thinking skills, due to GenAI use, will push 50% of the global organizations to require “AI-free” skills assessments
entries.subject: AI-free skills assessments
entries.metric: share of global organizations requiring AI-free skills assessments

entries.quote: By 2027, 35% of countries will be locked into region-specific AI platforms using proprietary contextual data
entries.subject: Sovereign / region-specific AI platforms
entries.metric: share of countries locked into region-specific AI platforms

entries.quote: By 2028, organizations that leverage multiagent AI for 80% of customer-facing business processes will dominate
entries.subject: Multiagent AI in customer-facing processes
entries.metric: share of customer-facing business processes using multiagent AI (dominance threshold)
entries.note: Qualitative outcome (organizations will dominate); 80% is the adoption threshold, not the forecast share.

entries.quote: By 2028, 90% of B2B buying will be AI agent intermediated, pushing over $15 trillion of B2B spend through AI agent exchanges
entries.subject: AI agents in B2B buying
entries.metric: share of B2B buying intermediated by AI agents
entries.note: Also: over $15 trillion of B2B spend through AI agent exchanges.

entries.quote: By the end of 2026, “death by AI” legal claims will exceed 2,000 due to insufficient AI risk guardrails
entries.subject: AI safety legal claims (death by AI)

entries.quote: By 2030, 20% of monetary transactions will be programmable to include terms and conditions of use, to give AI agents economic agency
entries.subject: Programmable money for AI agents
entries.metric: share of monetary transactions that are programmable

entries.quote: By 2027, the cost-to-value gap for process-centric service contracts will be reduced by at least 50% due to agentic AI reinvention
entries.subject: Agentic AI in service contracts
entries.metric: reduction in cost-to-value gap for process-centric service contracts

entries.quote: By 2027, fragmented AI regulation will grow to cover 50% of the world’s economies, driving $5 billion in compliance investment
entries.subject: AI regulation
entries.metric: share of world economies covered by AI regulation

notes: Edition covers '2026 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Strategic Predictions for 2026 and Beyond" (paywalled). gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
